bias.zh: 转弱 · 跌破 $301 底部

read.en: Coherent fell 7.9% on Oct 12 to $288.02, down 14% in five sessions, and broke below the $301 floor that had held five times since May. It is under the 5 and 10-day averages ($315), the 30-day ($299), the 200-day ($293) and the 100-day ($326). MACD crossed below its signal and Parabolic SAR flipped bearish on Oct 12; RSI is 45.
read.zh: Coherent 10月12日下跌 7.9%，收于 $288.02，五个交易日下跌 14%，跌破自 5月以来五次守住的 $301 底部。股价位于 5 日和 10 日均线（$315）、30 日（$299）、200 日（$293）和 100 日均线（$326）下方。MACD 于 10月12日下穿信号线，抛物线 SAR 同日转空；RSI 为 45。

read.en: The day's low of $284 is first support, then the Sep 28 low at $276 and the Sep 3 low at $255. The old floor at $293–301 (200 and 30-day averages) is now resistance; above it, the 5 and 10-day averages near $315 and the Oct 5 high of $342.
read.zh: 当日低点 $284 为第一支撑，其次 9月28日低点 $276 和 9月3日低点 $255。原先的底部 $293–301（200 日和 30 日均线）已转为阻力；其上为约 $315 的 5 日和 10 日均线，以及 10月5日高点 $342。

r.en: Oct 5 high; top of the range
